lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Cleat
lines.text:
Harbourmaster. This ledger is the port's
word. Right now it's the clerk's word.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Cleat
lines.text:
It says he keeps it. Says the crates are
copied. Says no ship is coming.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Cleat
lines.text:
And the Lighthouse order's at the bottom,
under everything. It goes on top.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text:
c is d that leaves you typing: cw changes
a word, ct, up to a comma, C to the end.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: P puts above the cursor. yy copies a line.

line.speaker: npc
line.name: Cleat
line.text:
Real crates. A ferry today. Rope for the
Lighthouse. The port's word again.

line.speaker: npc
line.name: Ream
line.text:
And the clerk? He's copying the ledger.
The right one, this time.

line.speaker: system
line.text:
Past the harbour, a library with its doors
chained. Every chain is a contract.
